name: BN4's Navis in BN6's engine
now: Mapped Navi by Navi (docs/multirom/bn4-navis.md; src/emu/bn4.h and bn4_navis.h, docs/rom/bn4.md's BN4's Navis rows; tools/bn4_navis.py). Each of the eighteen is a first-kind type of its own (BN4_NAVI_TYPE_*), run by the Navi pre-step 0x080135A8 and runner 0x08013DB4 (r6 its collision data, r7 its AI data, as BN6's Navi status dispatcher 0x0801AF44 runs a Navi's state) on a state table that opens with BN4's six generic Navi states. Ten Soul Navis take their side's AI data (0x0800C09A; +0x64 their own, BN6's +0x80; +0x70 the attack's, BN6's +0xA0) and run MegaMan's states 44-111 as theirs (BN4_PLAYER_STATES 0x080EAEFC); eight keep their variables in the object. GutsMan derived by tools/xnavirecipe_bn4.py (BN4_GUTSMAN 0x080B73C8, his state table 0x080B7458): his own block, MegaMan's 67-70 and the MegaMan routines and callbacks they reach copied, four third-kind objects moved, 59 calls out paired (five new pairs in tools/bn4_twins.py, BN6's object_crackPanel 0x0800C938 among them, audited) or copied (the state set, the attack's end, four engine routines with no BN6 body), 43 immediates (his AI data's blocks, CurActions, the panel's side, the collision data, element, objects' types and sprites), his palette 0 (BN4_NAVI_PALETTE's step 0). BN4's battle with GutsMan V1 alone, fought twice, is the same at every one of 1200 fight frames (tests/xdiff/bn4_gutsman_control.json: PASS); his machine gun's shots and his other objects appear in it. GutsMan built (src/emu/xnavi_bn4.c, the generator's whole recipe): installed where BN4's ROM is read, after BN4's families, as BN6's Navi AI 49 (ids 0x384-0x387) in BN4's Navis' room (FREE_BN4_NAVIS), his battle sprite at list 2 0x41, his five sounds in the pool of BN6's empty song slots (the owner's call 11); seen in BN6's battle (foes 384@52); his own collision setup argument (0x21) kept by a spawn-end shim; his sounds' pool pointed by battle; gutsman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames (the shake's draws paired, a cracked panel's field mapped, his sounds paired, his rocks' player read at BN6's place, the rocks' debris each engine's own art), five mutations of his port caught; the attack's end's clear of AI data +9, +0xA, +0xB, +0x30, +0x32 read: MegaMan's buster charge, inert on a Navi's AI data in BN6. His battle sprite is no longer resident: BN4's Navis' battle sprites share one 64 KB room (FREE_BN4_NAVI_SPRITE, XN_BN4_SPRITE; src/emu/xnavi_bn4_room.c), each Navi's list 2 entry pointed at it and his BN4 list 2 number in a table of seats (XN_BN4_SPRITES), filled from the player's BN4 ROM (LZ77'd unpacked) as a battle's record is written (emu_encounter_set), before his init's sprite_load; the generator places every Navi's battle sprite there (xnavirecipe_bn4.battle_sprite_place) and the comparator reads the room as the battle's Navi's (xdiff_bn4.sprite_rows); gutsman_v1 PASSes on it and a mutation filling it with another's sprite is caught at t1. He joins the tournament's pool (src/layer/xguardian_bn4.c's list of proved Navis, navi 35, BN4's own plate 0x00). ThunderMan proved (2026-11-08): thunderman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, his companion and cloud gated a fight frame later with his first own state (XV_FIGHT_FLAGS), four mutations of his port caught. WindMan (BN6's Navi AI 50, ids 0x388-0x38B) proved: windman_v1 PASSes, four mutations of his port caught. FireMan (BN6's Navi AI 52, ids 0x390-0x393) proved: fireman_v1 PASSes, six mutations of his port caught. The three, merged into one branch with every spec passing, wait for their plates on BN4's bracket to join the tournament's proved list. SearchMan (BN6's Navi AI 51, ids 0x38C-0x38F) proved: searchman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, his hiding run as BN4's (the collision data's invisibility at BN6's +0x26, BN4's hide step and marker copied and run before each of his states, which BN6's status step lacks), his scope and shots' trails (the fourth kind's 0x2E and 0x31) moved (his scope's state 61 not reached by the spec), seven mutations of his port caught; he joins the tournament's proved list on his plate 0x09. AquaMan (BN6's Navi AI 58, ids 0x3A8-0x3AB) proved: aquaman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, six mutations of his port caught; his panel kept at his +6 at his spawn's end (XnInit.home), his companion (the first kind's 0x5C, kind 1) on its kind's sprite, his effects handed BN4_EFFECT_PATTERN and spawned with his side moved, his effects' and objects' sprites another Navi copied shared; his companion's animation from the opening compared by the fight's frames (legit.json's bn4 companion_clock). He joins the tournament's proved list on his plate, BN4_PLATE_AQUAMAN. Roll (BN6's Navi AI 48, ids 0x380-0x383) built (2026-11-08): her call before the pre-step as BN6's hook A, her own states 1 and 2, MegaMan's 44-48 as hers, her flash (the fourth kind's 0x17) moved with her, her summon (BN4_SPAWN_ENEMY) by a shim of her code room that picks the panel as BN4's does and spawns by BN6_SPAWN_ENEMY_1, her player-22 sounds on BN6's player 9 (BN6 keeps 22 for its hit sound alone); bn4_roll_control PASSes, roll_v1 the same t1-t1007 and holds a recorded FAIL at t1008, where the Mettaur she summons is each engine's own (BN6's standing in by name), seven mutations of her port caught. Not in the tournament's proved list until her summon is proved: BN4's Mettaur mapped or moved, the owner's call. The three branches folded (8 November 2026: NAVIS SearchMan, AquaMan, Roll; one reading of the effects passed in a register, pattern_effects). Their attacks' art and pool songs loaded by battle into one room from the player's BN4 ROM, as their battle sprites are (src/emu/xnavi_bn4_art.c, XN_BN4_ARTS a byte a seat; tools/xnavirecipe_bn4_art.py lays each Navi's out from the room's start), the art's room back at +0x750000: the largest, SearchMan's, 0x11F00 bytes of its 0x2C000. Roll proved: her summon brings BN4's Mettaur moved for her (AI 70, ids 0x2E4-0x2E9), arriving by BN4's own summoned appear (its generic state 0 and 0x0801002A copied with it; the summon's shim marks +5 2 and runs BN6_VIRUS_INIT in the spawn frame); the comparison counts a Navi's summoned families as hers; roll_v1 PASSes over 1200 frames, three summon mutations caught; in xguardian_bn4.c's proved list. WoodMan proved (8 November 2026; docs/rom/bn4.md's WoodMan derived): his type 0x46 as Navi AI 59, ids 0x3AC-0x3AF, his seat 11; MegaMan's 77 and 106-108 as his 7-10; his attack's end with its CurAction alone (BN4_ATTACK_END_BARE 0x0800CA4A) copied; his MegaMan state 108's shot kinds (0x080F50E4) raw with its routine; four third kinds moved (0x07, 0x0B, 0x94, 0x95), the third kind's dispatch numbers past 0xFF from 0xCC (xrecipe_bn4.TYPE_MORE: BN5 has 204 third-kind types); his 0x95's final damage (BN4 +0x28, BN6 +0x80, past an ldrh's reach) read through a shim of his home (XnFar, xnavi_init.c). As the eighth BN4 Navi he took two caps past their sizes: the Navis installed (16, now BN5's homes and BN4's seats) and the moved enemy ids (256, now 384); the moved ranges' list is on the heap. bn4_woodman_control and woodman_v1 PASS over 1200 frames (the comparator: a pointer into a Soul Navi's AI data by BN6's places, legit.json's bn4 ai_data; his 0x94's spawn's r2 each game's camera; his pool sounds), six mutations caught; in xguardian_bn4.c's proved list. Roll's versions proved (2026-11-08): roll_v2, roll_v3 and roll_sp PASS over 1200 frames and roll_v2_summons over 2400, Billy2 arriving at t2050 by BN4's summoned appear: every enemy a summon spawns runs its state 0 from the table of the family moved for the summon (src/emu/xnavi_summoned.c, a hook on BN6_VIRUS_STATE_CALL keyed by BN4_SUMMON_MARK at BN6_T1_SPAWN_KIND), a visitor's own state 0 left BN6's; her pool's songs on players apart (10, past her Mettaur's 9); every BN4 Navi's SP palette set by version at its spawn's end (XNavi.palettes, BN6_AI_VERSION); seven mutations caught. JunkMan (BN6's Navi AI 57, ids 0x3A4-0x3A7) proved: junkman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, four mutations of his port caught; his update's two calls between his pre-step and his runner made by his hook A's shim (XNavi.pre), his states run with BN4's runner's r4 (his +0 byte without BN6's 0x24 bits) by stubs of his home (XNavi.runner_r4), his records' list 1 read by BN4's preload alone (record_list), his junk (the third kind's 0x96) and three more third-kind objects moved at the dispatch's 0xCF-0xD2. He joins the tournament's proved list on his plate, BN4_PLATE_JUNKMAN. TopMan (BN6's Navi AI 60, ids 0x3B0-0x3B3), the first of the other build (no AI data, every state his own), proved (2026-11-11): topman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, five mutations of his port caught; his palette set by version without BN4_NAVI_PALETTE (navi_palette_set), his decision's collision +0x1E and +5 at BN6's +0x2E and +7 (COLL4TO6), his top (the third kind's 0x1B, at the dispatch's 0xD3) drawn with his own battle sprite at XNAVI_SPRITE_BN4 + his seat (own_sprite); the comparator explains his BN4 object's missing AI data by the virus masks for the other build alone (NAVI_NO_AI). He joins the tournament's proved list on his plate, BN4_PLATE_TOPMAN. SparkMan (BN6's Navi AI 64, ids 0x3C0-0x3C3), the second of the other build, proved (2026-11-11): sparkman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames; his CurAction kept at his +0x60 and written back given BN6's numbers at every store (saved_actions), a mask of the collision words kept as a number, his object drawn as each engine's own MegaMan (ENGINE_SPRITES), his effect by version from a table his object's block holds (EFFECT_TABLES, XvByte), one effect drawn with his own battle sprite; his five third-kind objects at the dispatch's 0xD4-0xD8; the comparator's navi_kept_actions and navi_opening_art, and his 0x22's leftover r7. BN4's Navis' effects, list 4 and list 5 numbers past their ranges split with the chips' generator (EFFECT_MORE 0xE0-0xEC then 0xB1, LIST4_MORE 0x70 up, LIST5_MORE 0xB0 up). BurnerMan (BN6's Navi AI 62, ids 0x3B8-0x3BB), the third of the other build, proved (2026-11-11): burnerman_v1 PASSes over its 1200 frames, four mutations caught; his init's tail run at his spawn's end (XnInit.tail), his update's calls with a number in r0, his flames gated a frame longer by the dispatch's XV_FIGHT_STOP, his 0x38's test of his CurAction through its word (NAVI_WORDS), a pattern highlight copied with BN6's table of the same patterns (DATA_TWINS), a spawner wrapper's object (SPAWN_WRAPPERS), a byte store widened to BN6's place (STRB_WIDENS).
left: A sound past 0xFF named by a table's byte (the shim built for a movs alone); his arm points from his sprite (BN6's MegaMan's record stands in); a battle-state player read assumes MegaMan's side 0 (every battle a BN4 Navi is fought in); his own Navi chip for his tournament rounds (a BN6 Navi chip drawn from the round's band stands in, the owner's call of 6 November 2026). The next Navi (MetalMan's MetalGears are BN4 actor obstacles, the first such object to move; the third kind's dispatch numbers past TYPE_MORE's range the 32 the chips' generator leaves to the Navis, TYPES3_NAVIS); which of MegaMan's own actions reach states 44-111; Roll's V3 past her first summon: Billy3 and 0x39 (V3's type 0x11, its family moved apart) reached by no spec; a summon's word one per core (one summoning Navi, Roll). WoodMan's MegaMan's 77 (his CurAction 7, where 0x08012F96's flags have 0x4000) and his 0x95's hits read (the far load's shim) reached by no spec: MegaMan idle in woodman_v1.
